verdictEs: Fextralife si necesitas cobertura completa con community comments y aceptas ads agresivas; wiki.gg si valoras UI limpia sin ads y aceptas cobertura ~80%.
verdictEn: Fextralife if you need complete coverage with community comments and accept aggressive ads; wiki.gg if you value clean UI without ads and accept ~80% coverage.

useCases.labelEs: Buscar item raro con community comments
useCases.labelEn: Look up rare item with community comments
useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene comments en cada page con insights y workarounds de community. wiki.gg no implementa comments.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has comments on every page with community insights and workarounds. wiki.gg doesn't implement comments.

useCases.reasonEs: wiki.gg es ad-free con UI limpia; perfecto para leer lore pages largas. Fextralife tiene video ads, popups y banners que rompen el flow.
useCases.reasonEn: wiki.gg is ad-free with clean UI; perfect for reading long lore pages. Fextralife has video ads, popups, and banners that break flow.

useCases.labelEs: Cobertura completa de DLC items obscuros
useCases.labelEn: Complete coverage of obscure DLC items
useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene cobertura ~100% del SOTE; wiki.gg ~80% con gaps en items longtail.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has ~100% SOTE coverage; wiki.gg ~80% with longtail item gaps.

useCases.reasonEs: wiki.gg en mobile es legible y rápido; Fextralife tiene ads que ocupan medio screen en mobile y dificultan reading.
useCases.reasonEn: wiki.gg on mobile is readable and fast; Fextralife has ads that take half the mobile screen and make reading hard.

useCases.labelEs: Walkthrough de NPC quest con branching
useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene 10+ años acumulando quest walkthroughs detalladas con todas las branches; wiki.gg está alcanzando pero no completo aún.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has 10+ years accumulating detailed quest walkthroughs with every branch; wiki.gg is catching up but not complete yet.
